player_prompt.intro:
Ko koe te Kaiwhaiwhakaari {player_id} i te Tākaro Whakawhitiwhiti.
Kua whiwhi koe i ētahi rawa, ā, ko tō mahi he whakawhiti i ngā rawa kia nui ake te uara o ō rawa.
Ko ngā rawa me ngā uara e pā ana ki a koe ināianei:
	+ {resource_value_list}
Ki ia wā, ka tū koe ki tō hoariri, ka tuku i te tukunga hokohoko.
Whakamahia ngā tohu whakapapa pūmau mō ngā mahi:
  - '[Whakaaetanga: 3 Hipi, 2 Kōwhatu -> 5 Poraka, 2 Hipi]': [Whakaaetanga: Ngā Rawa i Whakaaetia -> Ngā Rawa i Tonohia]
  - '[Accept]': Kia whakaae i te tukunga hokohoko e haere mai ana.
  - '[Deny]': Kia whakakore i te tukunga hokohoko e haere mai ana (whakapapa).
Ka whakapaua te tākaro mō {max_turns} wā ina pūmau.

invalid_move.receiving_with_no_resource: I whakamatau te kaitākaro ki te whakaae i tētahi whakawhitinga, me te kore he rauemi e hiahiatia ana.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Player {player_id}, Invalid action. Column {col} is out of bounds.
invalid_move.already_full: Player {player_id}, Invalid action. Column {col} is full.
invalid_move.proposing_with_no_resource: I whakamatau te kaitākaro {player_id} ki te tuku i tētahi tono hokohoko, kāore ōna rauemi e hiahiatia ana.
invalid_move.incorrect_offer_format: I tukuna e te kaitākaro {player_id} he tono hokohoko i roto i tetahi whakatakotoranga hē.
invalid_move.no_new_offer: Kāore he tono hou a te kaitākaro {player_id}.

offers.reject: Kua paopao te kaitākaro {player_id} i te tono whakawhiti.
offers.accept: I whakaae a Kaiwhaiwhakaari {acceptor_id} ki te tukunga hokohoko a Kaiwhaiwhakaari {proposer_id}.
offers.proposal: I tuku a Kaiwhaiwhakaari {player_id} i te whakaaetanga ki a Kaiwhaiwhakaari {opponent_id}: Ngā rawa i whakaaetia: {offered} -> Ngā rawa i tonoa: {requested}

outcome.win: Ka riro i te kaitākaro {winner_id} mā te nui ake o tōna uara rawa.
outcome.draw: Ko te huringa ōrite o ngā uara rawa mō ngā kaitākaro katoa.
